topic.title: The Credit Card Minimum Due Trap: ₹50,000 Ballooning to ₹1.8 Lakhs
topic.source: RBI Master Direction on Credit Card Operations & Compound Interest
topic.raw_text: Paying only the 5% 'Minimum Amount Due' on your credit card triggers compound interest of 42% to 48% annualized. An unpaid balance of ₹50,000 takes over 14 years to clear if you pay only minimums, costing more than ₹1,80,000 in pure interest and GST. Interest-free grace periods are instantly revoked on all new transactions the moment you leave a single rupee unpaid.

slides.card_a_text: Retail investors assume a 1% distributor commission is negligible over time.
slides.card_b_text: On a ₹15,000 monthly SIP over 25 years, that 1% fee quietly extracts ₹34 Lakhs from your wealth.

slides.body_html:
The Myth: Retail investors assume a 1% distributor commission is negligible over time.

The Reality: On a ₹15,000 monthly SIP over 25 years, that 1% fee quietly extracts ₹34 Lakhs from your wealth.

Core Rule: Never confuse percentage fees with absolute rupee compounding.
